summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CLOSR CRM Integration Layer. All 34 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend Integration Health Status component verified working correctly with MOCK badge display.
test_credentials: None required - all tests use mock_mode=true
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_VinSolutions Mock integration and TEST_Webhook HMAC for testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM Integration Layer fully tested: 1) All 7 CRM adapters available (vinsolutions, dealersocket, elead, cdk, dealertrack, reynolds, promax), 2) Mock mode working - creates/syncs mock customer data without real CRM credentials, 3) Webhook authentication working - correctly rejects requests without valid HMAC signature, 4) Health status aggregation working - shows healthy/degraded/unhealthy counts, 5) Frontend IntegrationHealthStatus component displays '1/1 CRM' with MOCK badge in header

crm_adapters.details: GET /api/integrations/adapters returns all 7 CRM types + generic_rest with proper metadata (name, vendor, tier, authMethods)

integration_crud.details: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/integrations working. Create with mock_mode=true, list, get by ID, toggle mock mode all verified

mock_mode_sync.details: POST /api/integrations/{id}/sync returns mock customer data. Test connection returns 'Mock mode enabled - connection test simulated successfully'

health_status.details: GET /api/integrations/health returns aggregated status with total, healthy, degraded, unhealthy, unknown, mock_mode counts and overall_status

webhook_registration.details: POST /api/webhooks creates webhook with HMAC auth, returns webhook_id, endpoint_url, and credentials (hmac_secret, api_key)

webhook_authentication.details: POST /api/webhooks/{id}/receive correctly rejects requests without valid HMAC signature (returns 401 'Invalid HMAC signature')

frontend_health_component.details: IntegrationHealthStatus component in header shows '1/1 CRM' with green checkmark and 'MOCK' badge when integrations are in mock mode

mocked_apis_note: CRM connectors operate in mock_mode which generates realistic fake data (customers with names, phones, emails, vehicle interests) instead of calling real CRM APIs. This is intentional per user request - when real CRM credentials are introduced, mock_mode can be set to false.
